info.title: Hand Maid May (ITA)
info.synopsis: Saotome Kazuya è un genio del computer. Un giorno, il suo amico Nanbara lo minaccia con un virus informatico. Cercando di fermare il virus, Kazuya finisce per fare un ordine speciale. May è una cyberdoll che arriva alla sua porta pochi minuti dopo, ed è grande solo un sesto di una persona normale, cosa che porta a molte situazioni imbarazzanti. Senza contare che Kazuya non può nemmeno permettersi di mantenere May. La Cyberdyne non è soddisfatta dei mancati pagamenti di Kazuya e farà di tutto per recuperare la CBD May.

overview.value: Saotome Kazuya is threatened with a computer virus. Trying to stop the virus, he makes a special order. May is a cyberdoll that arrives at his door a few minutes later and she is 1/6th the size of a normal person.

translations.title: HAND MAID メイ
translations.overview:
２０００年。

主人公、早乙女和也は「ドラ●もんを作ること」に熱中する、ちょっとかわった大学生。美人看板娘が隣に住む年代モノのアパートの一室に住み、大学に通いながらも毎日研究にいそしんでいる。

ところがある日、悪友・南原耕太郎から貰った「特製南原ウィルス入りのＤＶＤ」を、自宅のパソコンにうっかりロードしてしまったからさあ大変！　和也の必至の抵抗で、なんとか「南原ウィルス」の侵攻を食い止めるのだが、パソコン画面には謎の「ＯＲＤＥＲ　ＭＡＤＥ」のメッセージが…。

その後、程なくして「サイバーダイン社」と記載された心当たりのない小包みが和也の元に送られてきた。その包みの中に入っていたものは、1/6サイズの人形『サイバドール・メイ』。なんと自分の意志で動き、話をする不思議なロボットだった！

ここから始まる、和也とメイの物語。『HAND MAID メイ』は、老若男女、個性剥き出しのキャラクター達が次々と登場し、画面狭しと大暴れするドタバタコメディだ！

episodes.title: Episodio 1
episodes.synopsis: After his computer is infected with a virus, by his self-proclaimed rival Nanbara, a package appears at computer programmer Satome Kazuya's doorstep the next day. The package contains a 12" tall Cyberdoll named May.

tmdb.title: Episodio 1
tmdb.synopsis: After his computer is infected with a virus, by his self-proclaimed rival Nanbara, a package appears at computer programmer Satome Kazuya's doorstep the next day. The package contains a 12" tall Cyberdoll named May.

episodes.title: Episodio 2
episodes.synopsis: After telling May to stay in the apartment, Kazuya goes off to school. Later, Nanbara calls Kazuya's apartment only to hear a woman's voice on the other end, and soon tries to sabotage the relationship he believes Kazuya is having with a secret woman. Also, another Cyberdoll named Sara has come to collect the bill for May. [1,450,000 Yen]

episodes.title: Episodio 10
episodes.synopsis: In the series finale, it is discovered that the deadly Cyberdoll virus was created within May when she was converted from 1/6 scale to full size. "Commando Z" reveals himself to be a time-traveler from the future to dicover the virus' origins and stop it before it destys all the Cyberdolls. Since May is immune to the virus, she volunteers herself to be infected with it to allow further study on the virus and a possible cure. But everyone is worried that May may not make it out alive...

info.title: Hand Maid May (ITA)

May è una cyberdoll che arriva alla sua porta pochi minuti dopo, ed è grande solo un sesto di una persona normale, cosa che porta a molte situazioni imbarazzanti. Senza contare che Kazuya non può nemmeno permettersi di mantenere May. La Cyberdyne non è soddisfatta dei mancati pagamenti di Kazuya e farà di tutto per recuperare la CBD May.
